Eligibility, duration & fee

BSc and MSc in Clinical Embryology

How long are the BSc and MSc in Clinical Embryology at Bahra University, and what is the fee?

The BSc in Clinical Embryology at Bahra University, Shimla Hills, Himachal Pradesh, runs 4 Years for students with 12th in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, at ₹39,875 per semester. The MSc in Clinical Embryology runs 2 Years (4 Semesters) at INR 1,00,000/- Per Semester.

BSc in Clinical Embryology

Who can apply for the BSc in Clinical Embryology?

Eligibility: 12th with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

How long is the BSc in Clinical Embryology?

Duration: 4 Years

What is the fee for the BSc in Clinical Embryology?

Fee: ₹39,875 per semester

Apply Now for the BSc in Clinical Embryology

MSc in Clinical Embryology

Who can apply for the MSc in Clinical Embryology?

Eligibility: Undergraduate / B.Sc. Life Sciences, Embryology, Nutrigenetics, Genetics, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Anthropology, Human Biology, MLT / MBBS, BDS, BVSc., and Allied Sciences

How long is the MSc in Clinical Embryology?

Duration: 2 Years (4 Semesters)

What is the fee for the MSc in Clinical Embryology?

Course Fee: INR 1,00,000/- Per Semester

Career Opportunities

What careers can Clinical Embryology graduates pursue?

Graduates can pursue rewarding careers as:

  • Clinical Embryologists
  • Reproductive Technologists
  • Academic Researchers
  • IVF Lab Specialists
  • ART Laboratory Managers
